newsitem.title: USA: Glendale Federal to form holding company.
newsitem.headline: Glendale Federal to form holding company.

text.p: Glendale Federal Bank said it was forming a holding company, Golden State Bancorp Inc.
It said it had filed an application with the U.S. Office of Thrift Supervision and a related registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission about the proposed reorganization.
Under the plan, Glendale's common stock will be exchanged for Golden State stock on a share-for-share basis, and Glendale would become a subsidiary of Golden State.
Glendale's noncumulative preferred stock, Series E, would be exchanged for an equal number of shares of Golden State preferred stock having equivalent terms.
Glendale's two classes of warrants would become exercisable solely to purchase common stock of Golden State.
